featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Disappointed – Misleading Promises & Zero Responsibility

I bought my car from Maruti Suzuki True Value on July 2025, and till today (28th October 2025) my insurance papers are still not transferred in my name. Now that my car met with an accident, I’m unable to claim insurance because of their delay!

When buying the car, the staff kept saying “Trust us, we will handle everything.” They made us believe they’re professional and reliable. But once the payment was done, they completely stopped taking responsibility.

Even during booking, they delayed delivery by 5–10 days and then blamed the finance company. When I tried to cancel, they kept requesting not to cancel, calling repeatedly. But now, when I actually need help, no one is responding.

This is how True Value and their finance company work — no accountability, no follow-up, and no respect for customer trust.
I trusted them with my money and my car, and this is the result. Extremely disappointed and angry with their service.

Now what should I do about my car , now who will give me claim and all

Worst experience ever, zero customer support.
